correctness.rationale: The conditional order-statistic beta moment yields every in-window covariance; order-invariance forces every out-of-window covariance to vanish. Exact rational enumeration passed 7472 checks through n=8, but general truth rests on the reconstructed proof in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: The complete finite-band cross-covariance of global record events and local ordinal pattern events, exact cancellation to bounded constants for all fixed pattern lengths, sharp global extremizers and a triple-pattern sign reversal give a natural nontrivial second-moment classification. It is not merely marginal enumeration or relabeling; it quantifies information invisible to separate record and pattern laws.
